# Inline SVG icons in the renderer

The renderer imports only a handful of lucide icons (`icons/lucide/manifest.json`); nearly every glyph is a
hand-written inline SVG. Nothing here is converted: port each one from its source (paths relative to
`electron-client/src/`, grep the component name). Most share one idiom: a 24-unit viewBox, `fill="none"`,
`stroke="currentColor"`, round caps and joins, so the glyph takes the text colour.

## Icon components (62)

or exported from an `icons.tsx`. `Svg` wrappers in an `icons.tsx` supply the viewBox and stroke of the icons in that file.

## Stroke widths written on inline SVGs

Literal `strokeWidth` attributes in the components above (on `<svg>` elements and their children) and how often
each appears; an expression counts under its first number, and the voice stage's `...stroke(bold ? 2.5 : 2)` helper
is not counted. Lucide icons scale their stroke with the icon size (`icons/lucide/manifest.json`); these do too,
since the stroke is in viewBox units.

`0.5` ×1, `1` ×4, `1.1` ×2, `1.5` ×8, `1.6` ×1, `1.8` ×1, `2` ×103, `2.2` ×3, `2.25` ×1, `2.4` ×1, `2.5` ×32, `2.75` ×1, `3` ×15
